title: Lebanese Lentils, Rice & Fried Onions (Mujadara) with Chopped Salad

steps.text: Using a strainer or colander, rinse lentils under cold water; drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and salt, then bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 10 minutes (the lentils will not be cooked all the way through).
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-low heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and thinly slice onion into half-moons.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the onion, cumin, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until soft and golden brown, about 15 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
While the onions are cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and add to the saucepan with the lentils; return to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid returns to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook lentils and rice until tender and liquid is mostly absorbed, 18-20 minutes more. Once done, remove from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Place in a large bowl along with oil, vinegar, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing.
Trim and small dice cucumber; small dice tomatoes. Add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Stack lettuce leaves, one on top of another; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Add feta to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad and the lentil-rice mixture between plates; top lentils and rice with fried onions. Enjoy!
